biology: The host is recorded as Pinus elliottii.
soldier: Head orange-yellow, mandibles reddish brown and slightly transparent, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.55–0.56, the sides nearly parallel and gradually narrowing posteriorly, the posterior margin evenly rounded. The frontal ridge is distinctly raised, shallowly concave between the ridges. The labrum is lingulate, the apex roundly blunt, the apical hairs fine, the remaining hairs almost imperceptible. The mandibles are firm and slender, their apices rather strongly curved, the length 0.52–0.53 of the head capsule length and 0.94–0.95 of the head width. Antennae with 14–15 segments. The middle of the anterolateral margins of the broad region of the postmentum is concave, the broad region lies at the anterior one-fifth, the waist region slender and long with the two sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.33–0.34. The pronotum is 1.44–1.50 times as wide as long, the median notch of the anterior margin both broad and deep, the middle of the posterior margin slightly incised, with about sixteen hairs in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; it is in fact the genus Reticulitermes, the same genus name as currently used on this site.
